Lower Text: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When one of your Digimon with [Angoramon] in their texts deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle, trash the top card of their security stack.
Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if your opponent has no unsuspended Digimon, 1 of their Digimon can't unsuspend until the end of their turn.
